mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have 57 degree temperatures and clear skies near the Military Ridge State Trail. We also have a waxing gibbous moon, and keep an eye out for the International Space Station tonight at 5:49 PM as it drifts from the northwest over Middleton near Verona High School toward the northeast near Home Depot, remaining low near the horizon.

The City of Verona has announced that city buildings will be closed for the Thanksgiving holiday on November 26 and 27, which means refuse and recycling pickup will be delayed until Friday, November 27. Additionally, the city is moving forward with a space needs evaluation for a new Public Works and Utilities facility to support our growing population.
There is a great lineup of local entertainment today, including live music at Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus and other venues this coming Tuesday.
Looking back at our weekly police report, on November 2, officers were dispatched to a residence on West End Circle where a 48-year-old man was arrested for battery and disorderly conduct.
If you are looking for a treat, today's flavor of the day is Crazy for Cookie Dough. The store is currently closed, but it opens today at 10:00 AM.
